description: The community of St. Stephen's Hounslow Conservation Area opens private gardens in celebration of our trees. St. Stephen's Road is defined by the century-old lime trees. Yet, all of the trees within the conservation area are protected, not just those along the road. Join us to visit a variety of public and private gardens, celebrating the rich history and biodiversity of our conservation area.

events.name: Drop in: St. Stephen's Hounslow - Open Gardens
events.notes: Collect maps to open gardens from St. Stephen's Church. Self-guided visits take place throughout the full 2-hour event.

facilities: Handrails on one side of stairs

factsheet.heading: Conservation and Biodiversity
paragraphs: St. Stephen's Road is a case study in the interdependence of historical and ecological conservation. Visitors may explore the interior and the grounds of St. Stephen's Church, our landmark and namesake. After the church, visitors may visit a selection of private gardens, glimpsing behind the intact Victorian hedgerows. Residents will share their experiences in caring for their natural spaces, showcasing the rich variety of plants and wildlife that are a part of the experience of living within the St. Stephen's Road Conservation Area.
